name: B10-0256/2025 (PPE) – Violations of religious freedom in Tibet
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns what it calls repressive policies in Tibet and Chinese interference in choosing Tibetan Buddhist leaders. It expresses sorrow over the death of Tibetan Buddhist leader Tulku Hungkar Dorje in custody in Vietnam and asks for an independent investigation. It also asks the European Union and its member states to raise these cases with China and Vietnam.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is a statement of concern and a set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** The EU's talks with China and Vietnam, and Tibetan religious communities.
- **What happens next:** Parliament asks the EU and member states to raise these cases with China and Vietnam and to demand accountability.
